name: Saeki Katsuya
source:
"Well then, shall we begin the entertainment?"

The other persona that appears when Katsuya puts on the glasses he received from Mr. R.
When he wears the glasses, his abilities increase beyond normal, allowing him to excel at his work. However, at the same time, his personality becomes brutal, and he sets his sights on male targets, trying to make them his. He is aggressive and dominant, taking pleasure in subjugating those stronger than himself. Gifted with decisiveness and a sharp ability to assess situations accurately, he excels at attacking his opponent’s weak points. He never allows himself to be at a disadvantage. In his dictionary, there is no such word as “impossible.”
